https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides automated cloud environments for software development and testing, enabling users to rapidly deploy, test, and iterate applications without manual provisioning.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create and manage cloud-based environments for software testing and development.
Users must be able to deploy applications to cloud environments with minimal setup time and effort.
Users must be able to view and monitor the status of active environments, including resource usage and application performance.
Users must be able to integrate the platform with CI/CD workflows for seamless deployment and testing automation.
Users must be able to duplicate or clone environments to recreate testing scenarios or troubleshoot issues.
Users must be able to schedule or set expiration times for environments to optimize resource utilization.
Users must have role-based access control to ensure secure and appropriate usage of environments within teams.
